Most of us would just be happy to be normal.
But oh, brothers and sisters, we were made for so much more.
We are sons and daughters of the Most High God.
We are a chosen people, a royal, a royal, a kingly priesthood, a holy nation, a people
belonging to God that we may declare His praises.
Where we failed, Jesus Christ, our head has succeeded and now through Him, our lives, as frail as they are, are a display of God's infinite mercy and grace.
While we have breath, we live to glorify our God, but the day will come when we will die.
But even then, Jesus Christ has paved the way for his brothers and sisters to be raised
to life immortal, and to be brought into a new heavens, a new earth, where we will rule
by his side.
You know, we are all gods.
Really?
Well, for those who are in Christ, the answer is yes.
We have been born of God, and this is our destiny.
Revelation 22, the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city and his servants
will serve him. They will see his face and his name will be on their foreheads. There
will be no more night. They will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun for
the Lord God will give them light and they will reign forever and ever. Would you pray
with me. Our heavenly father, if your words are true, then father, we confess that we have
viewed ourselves far too small. Lord, we have thought of ourselves as products of chance.
We thought of life as meaningless. We have conducted ourselves in ways that betray our
unbelief in you. Oh but God you this morning speak to us a vision of who you
are and who we are made in your image. Father we thank you for Jesus Christ
your son the one true King who restores us to what we ought to be. Oh Lord
caused us to place our trust in Him and not in any other ruler.
And Lord, we pray that You would be glorified as we live in submission to Him.
Pray all these things in Christ's name. Amen.
